elements.label: Headline 'Universal Context' with TM moving up

pattern.description: The settled 'Universal Context™' headline translates upward by roughly 65 px as a unit, clearing the lower-centre of the frame above the line-field horizon for what comes next.
pattern.why_premium: Moving the existing headline instead of cutting keeps the viewer anchored on the product term while space is made for the next element; a single smooth vertical shift reads as deliberate composition.

build_hint.remotion: translateY = interpolate(frame, [start, start + 14], [0, -65], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) or a critically damped spring (damping 200) with no overshoot.

notes: Energy rises monotonically to the last burst frame, so the move may continue past the burst (or be cut into); the easing guess is weak. The bottom line-field is denser than at the end of e014 but no change is visible within this burst's crops, so it is not listed. b04/b07 are diff boxes at the headline's old position.
